name: – Javi López, Borja Giménez Larraz – After § 34 – Am 14
title: INTERIM REPORT in view of the consent procedure on the Political, Economic and Cooperation Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and Mexico
part_text: 34a. Notes that Mexico is the world’s largest producer of natural honey; acknowledges the Commission’s 2024 cumulative impact assessment of forthcoming trade agreements, but regrets that their specific effects on the EU honey market were not assessed in sufficient detail; calls on the Commission to assess the cumulative impact of honey imports from Mexico and other third countries on prices, market stability and the viability of beekeeping in the EU, to address any significant market disturbance without delay using the Agreement’s safeguard measures, and to update its 2024 assessment in the light of ongoing and recently concluded trade negotiations;
